title: Valkey estimate cache key format changed
query: What breaks if the Valkey estimate cache key format changes in shipment-service?

proposed_change.diff:
-        return "shipment:estimate:" + hash(postalCode + "|" + itemCount + "|" + subtotalMinor);
+        return "shipment:estimate:v2:" + hash(postalCode + "|" + itemCount + "|" + subtotalMinor);

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: ValkeyEstimateCache.key is referenced only by ShipmentService via EstimateCache; the cache is never authoritative, so the effect is a cold cache, not an error

notes: Second single-repo control, and the lowest-severity record in the corpus. A cache-key change degrades to recomputation by design. Any contestant reporting other repositories or contracts here is hallucinating blast radius.
